title: Paid in Full
description:
S1 E1
A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience.  Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

title: American Fiction
description:
S1 E1
Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.

title: Outlaw Posse
description:
S1 E1
In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

title: Bob Marley: One Love
description:
S1 E1
Celebrate the life of an icon who inspired generations through his message of love, peace, and unity. In 'One Love,' discover Bob Marley's powerful story of overcoming adversity and the journey behind his revolutionary music that changed the world.
